composition.serve_who: Sheet 21 (dwg 196D5023) is an MPCS interconnect sheet documenting wiring from an ISG unit (labeled ISG-P, i.e. Port ISG) connector set P4/P3 through to the MPCS LV-1 connector (pins 30/31/13/14) plus a resistor-terminated line labeled "G3-7100 R_Key" landing on separate MPCS pins (11/12). All labeled signals (stator temperature sensor Hi/Lo, HVIL_IN/OUT) explicitly name ISG-P as the source device, so this sheet's content belongs to the Port ISG node (625-isg-port), with the far-end MPCS connector being infrastructure/cross-reference to the MPCS node.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Connector block explicitly labeled 'ISG-P' (P4 and P3) is the drawn source of all signal wires on this sheet; every signal name (stator temp, HVIL) is functionally tied to the ISG unit's internal sensors/safety loop, matching the established Port ISG node.

functions.label: Stator Temperature Sensor Signal to MPCS
functions.what_it_does: Carries the ISG stator temperature sensor's differential signal (Hi/Lo pair) from the generator's internal sensor out to the MPCS controller for monitoring/protection of the ISG windings.

flow_scenarios.path: ISG-P internal stator temperature sensor → connector P4 pin A (Hi, wire G3-7123) and pin B (Lo, wire G3-7124) → crossed/twisted wire pair (twist shown on sheet) → MPCS LV-1 connector pin 30 (Hi) and pin 31 (Lo) → MPCS analog input for stator temperature monitoring

key_components: Stator temperature sensor (internal to ISG, Hi/Lo differential output)
functions.dry_data: Differential analog signal pair, connector P4 pins A/B on ISG-P to MPCS LV-1 pins 30/31, wires twisted (shielded/twisted pair per drawn crossing symbol)

functions.label: HVIL (High Voltage Interlock Loop) In/Out
functions.what_it_does: Routes the high-voltage interlock loop signal through the ISG connector P3, allowing the MPCS to detect loop continuity (interlock closed) as a safety condition before/during high voltage operation involving the ISG.

flow_scenarios.path: MPCS LV-1 pin 13 → wire G3-7120 (HVIL_IN) → ISG-P connector P3 pin 1 → internal loop continuity → ISG-P connector P3 pin 2 → wire G3-7121 (HVIL_OUT) → MPCS LV-1 pin 14, closing the loop back to MPCS

Loop open at ISG-P P3 (connector disconnected/damaged) → MPCS sees open HVIL loop on pins 13/14 → MPCS interprets as high-voltage interlock fault (fault handling/response is on MPCS, not detailed on this sheet)

key_components: HVIL loop conductors (in/out) through ISG-P connector P3
functions.dry_data: Two-wire HVIL loop, ISG-P P3 pins 1/2, wires G3-7120/G3-7121, terminating at MPCS LV-1 pins 13/14

This sheet only shows the MPCS-side pin landing, not internal MPCS processing — full MPCS function is on the MPCS node/sheets
